metadataRaw.title: Self Reset Your Sacroiliac Joint 💥 #Shorts
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an easy way to self reset your sacroiliac joint (aka SI joint) for instant pain relief.

This exercise can be done at home, throughout the day, and requires only a basic broomstick. Also, you may find it can offer pelvic, hip, and sacroiliac joint pain relief within seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
